philippines.description:
CINCINNATI, United States — World number two Elena Rybakina had to quit her quarter-final at the ATP-WTA Cincinnati Masters, retiring while trailing Iga Swiatek 4-1 in the opening set on Thursday. philippines.title: Marcos urges Filipinos: Draw courage, conviction from Ninoy’s legacy
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday commemorated Ninoy Aquino Day by encouraging the Filipinos to draw from the legacy of the late senator in fighting for the country’s freedom and pushing for a progressive nation.  Marcos said that Aquino’s legacy is a reminder of the Filipinos’ courage to uphold convictions and contribute to the country’s democratic process. He also underscored that this day reaffirms the nation’s collective duty to live with honor and dignity.
